mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses equity discount rates by reducing risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% annualized triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, increasing equity discount rates and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous strength in housing starts (HOUST above 1750 thousand units) and retail sales (RSAFS above 660,000 million dollars) signals robust consumer demand, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST > 1750 and RSAFS > 660,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates a tight labor market that typically precedes wage-driven inflation, triggering central bank hawkishness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Positive month-over-month growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS above 100,000) indicates expanding labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 100,000, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1700 thousand units signal weak residential investment and declining consumer confidence, reducing overall demand and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1700, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) create a stagflationary environment where policy response is constrained, increasing equity risk premiums and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and potential economic contraction, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.
